title: Harvest Record Tracking Log
subtitle: Harvest Record: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Harvest Record Tracking Log covers crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff. The harvest operations owner records Harvest Record events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Harvest Record Tracking Log keeps Harvest Record exceptions visible until the harvest operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Harvest Record Tracking Log at field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location. Document crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff identity before Harvest Record begins. Compare crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff findings with stated Harvest Record criteria; route unresolved Harvest Record issues to farm production reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Harvest Record, identify responsible parties, field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location, and the linked crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff source.

fields.label: Farm, field, block, crop, and variety
Harvest date, crew, supervisor, and lot
Container, trailer, load, quantity, and destination

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Harvest Record facts for crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Harvest Record tracked controls
items: Crew, tool, container, and hygiene readiness
Transport, cooling, receiving, rejection, and loss

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Harvest Record chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Harvest Operations Owner, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Harvest Record when lot identity, crop condition, quantity, cooling, or receiving custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Harvest Record proof and route unresolved crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff scope to harvest operations owner.
